title: Crop the level boxes
summary: Cuts each labelled level box into a square grey crop of size x size pixels, the trainer's input.
does: The trainer's crop step (tools/train.py): each labelled box of a frame is cut with its pad, turned grey (Pillow's convert L), resized to size x size and scaled to 0..1 as float32; the network then repeats the grey channel three times. The experiment route passes no --size, so it trains at the default 64. A projected level mask (render_drr) would give each level's box by its extent; that reading is planned (docs/research/xr-from-3d/README.md), and the trainer reads only the catalog's boxes today.

inputs.name: frames
inputs.what: 2-D frames with level boxes, or (planned) projected level masks.

outputs.name: crops
outputs.what: One grey crop per labelled level, N x 1 x size x size, float32 in 0..1.

params.name: size
params.what: pixels a side; the trainer takes any (--size, default 64); the smoke check decides 32, 64, 96 and 128 (tools/block_sweep.py); 512 is the sandbox's cap

generic.why: The trainer cuts 2-D boxes from frames (tools/train.py); a volume or a clip would need a 3-D box or one crop per time step, which no code cuts yet.
